level.why: Who 問句，正解以不確定或視情況回應，干擾項混合音近與相關誘答。

q.t: Who should I talk to about extending my stay?
q.zh: 我想延長住宿，該找誰談？

pool.t: The manager usually decides that.
pool.why: 正解：指出負責人。

pool.t: It depends on availability next week.
pool.zh: 要看下週還有沒有空房。
pool.why: 正解：以條件迴避，間接回答。

pool.t: Let me see who's on duty.
pool.why: 正解：表示需要查證。

pool.t: Until the end of the week.
pool.why: Who 問句卻回答期間。

pool.t: Room two-ten, please.
pool.why: Who 問句卻回答房號。

pool.t: We'd like to expand the lobby.
pool.why: extend 與 expand 意思與音都相近，但沒回答。

pool.t: The weekend brunch is popular.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: Taxis wait outside the main door.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: There's a great inn in Kyoto.
pool.why: 與住宿相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: My stay has been wonderful.
pool.why: 重複 stay，沒有回答。

pool.t: I talk to my wife about travel.
pool.why: 重複 talk，談無關的事。

pool.t: He stayed here last spring.
pool.why: 談別人過去的事，沒有回答。

tag: 詢問客房是否可帶小型寵物

level.why: Yes/No 問句，正解以條件、視情況或查證回應，干擾項混合相關誘答。

q.t: Are small pets allowed in the guest rooms?
q.zh: 客房可以帶小型寵物嗎？

pool.t: We allow them with a small deposit.
pool.why: 正解：有條件地直接回答。

pool.t: It depends on the size of the pet.
pool.why: 正解：以條件迴避，間接回答。

pool.t: Let me check our policy for you.
pool.why: 正解：表示需要查證。

pool.t: Down the corridor, on the right.
pool.why: Yes/No 問句卻回答地點。

pool.t: Because he was tired.
pool.why: Yes/No 問句卻回答原因。

pool.t: We have a lovely rooftop terrace.
pool.zh: 我們有漂亮的屋頂露台。
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: The dining room serves dinner until ten.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: Parking is behind the building.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: I love small hotels.
pool.why: 重複 small，談個人喜好。

pool.t: My small suitcase is heavy.
pool.why: 重複 small，談行李。

pool.t: I never place bets.
pool.why: pets 與 bets 音近，但意思無關。

pool.t: The guests left an hour ago.
pool.why: 談客人過去的行為，沒有回答。

tag: 詢問鑰匙留櫃台或帶走

level.why: 選擇問句，正解以條件、無偏好或第三選項回應，干擾項混合音近與相關誘答。

q.t: Should I drop the key off at reception or keep it?
q.zh: 我該把鑰匙交到櫃台，還是自己留著？

pool.t: Whatever is easier for you.
pool.why: 正解：表達無偏好。

pool.t: Just leave it in the drop box.
pool.why: 正解：提出第三個選項。

pool.t: If you're back tonight, keep it.
pool.why: 正解：以條件選擇其中之一。

pool.t: At half past eleven.
pool.why: 選擇問句卻回答時間。

pool.t: Room four-oh-six.
pool.why: 選擇問句卻回答房號。

pool.t: The city tour leaves at nine.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: The restaurant is on the roof.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: The pool towels are free.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回答。

pool.t: I keep forgetting my passwords.
pool.why: 重複 keep，談無關的事。

pool.t: Reception was very helpful.
pool.why: 重複 reception，只是評論。

pool.t: Tea is served at four.
pool.why: key 與 tea 音近，但意思無關。

pool.t: She dropped it off yesterday.
pool.why: 談別人過去的行為，沒有回答。

level.why: 陳述句，正解需判斷說話者求助意圖，以協助、反問或同理回應，干擾項混合相關誘答。

q.t: I locked myself out of my room.
q.zh: 我把自己鎖在房間外面了。

pool.t: I'll bring you a spare key.
pool.why: 正解：主動提供協助。

pool.t: May I see your ID first?
pool.why: 正解：反問以確認身分。

pool.t: Oh no, that must be frustrating.
pool.zh: 哎呀，那一定很令人沮喪。
pool.why: 正解：表達同理。

pool.t: On the ground floor.
pool.why: 與陳述內容無關的地點回答。

pool.t: At two this afternoon.
pool.why: 與陳述內容無關的時間回答。

pool.t: The hallway lights are broken.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回應。

pool.t: My room faces the parking lot.
pool.why: 與房間相關，但沒有回應。

pool.t: Checkout is at noon.
pool.why: 與旅館相關，但沒有回應。

pool.t: I locked the car yesterday.
pool.why: 重複 locked，談無關的事。

pool.t: My room is on the sixth floor.
pool.why: 重複 room，沒有回應。

pool.t: I like rock music.
pool.why: lock 與 rock 音近，但意思無關。

pool.t: He locks up at ten every night.
pool.why: 談別人的習慣，沒有回應。

tag: 請鄰居晚上十點後降低音樂音量

level.why: 請求句，正解以接受、附理由婉拒或詢問細節回應，干擾項混合相關與音近誘答。

q.t: Could you keep the music down after ten?
q.zh: 你十點後可以把音樂關小聲嗎？

pool.t: Sure, I'll turn it down by then.
pool.why: 正解：接受請求。

pool.t: I'd rather not, it's my birthday party.
pool.zh: 我不想，今天是我的生日派對。
pool.why: 正解：婉拒並附理由。

pool.t: How loud is it from your side?
pool.zh: 你那邊聽起來有多大聲？
pool.why: 正解：詢問細節。

pool.t: Yes, I did.
pool.why: 請求句不能這樣回應。

pool.t: In the garden.
pool.why: 請求句卻回答地點。

pool.t: The concert starts at eight.
pool.why: 與音樂相關，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: My speakers are brand new.
pool.why: 與音樂相關，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: Our band practices on Sundays.
pool.why: 與音樂相關，但沒有回應請求。

pool.t: Music class is on Tuesdays.
pool.why: 重複 music，沒有回應請求。

pool.t: Ten people came to the party.
pool.why: 重複 ten，沒有回應請求。

pool.t: Then we went to the beach.
pool.why: ten 與 then 音近，但意思無關。

pool.t: She kept the radio down yesterday.
pool.zh: 她昨天把收音機開得很小聲。
pool.why: 談別人過去的行為，沒有回應。
